fusions.name: Quarry Mark
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a closing blow that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalking Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 15%.
